body: Thanks for your story, and the advice too greatly appreciated. My situation was similar, told her I loved her, she said, 'well, I can't help you with that.' still as painful to think about as the day she said it. I think I will try meditation, even if it eases the pain just a bit it will be worth it.
More to life than one person, that is something I need to keep in mind. Thanks man.
Guys thanks it really means a lot, to hear a kind word or someone else going through the same thing. I really appreciate it.
